free_tier.stated: One podcast, unlimited episodes: 'The free plan allows users to have one podcast with an unlimited number of episodes.' No total-storage or per-file figure is published on the plans page or in the free-plan announcement — the plans page renders unlimited episodes but no storage number.

egress.terms: Unmetered in the sense that no bandwidth cap or per-GB price is published for Free; the constraint is episode count and the house format.

tooling: No public upload API; dashboard and mobile app.
chaining: 1 podcast x unlimited episodes x N accounts. Storage ceiling is implicit (whatever the house transcode produces) rather than stated.
limits_note: Everything is transcoded into 'Spreaker Storage Format' — 'All audio that we stream must be in the same format: for this reason, sometimes it is necessary to transcode the audio files that are uploaded'. Upload lossless and it will not be double-transcoded, but it is still re-encoded once into the house format.
reliability_note: Definitively re-encodes — Spreaker's own help tells you to upload WAV/FLAC 'so they will not be transcoded' twice, which confirms the platform stores a single normalised format, not your master. No storage number published anywhere means the real ceiling is discoverable only by hitting it.
